services.name: In-Class
services.desc: This program takes scouts on a step-by-step, hands-on journey through the basics of constructing a scale model railroad. From painting and plastering to laying cork bed and track, by the time you are finished, you will have a small HO scale model railroad that you can add to over time and eventually make fully operational! It makes for a dynamic and fun experience that can be completed individually or collaboratively. Once you complete the program, scouts will receive the “Engineer Your Future STEAM Patch,” which is included in the price. services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Join us for a docent-led tour on Friday, September 11, 2026, at 11:30am. Included with admission, this 45-minute tour highlights our exhibits, the art of model railroading, and Southern California railroad history. Docent led tours are included in museum admission and the Balboa Park Explorer pass. No RSVP required. We are pleased to offer private tours of The San Diego Railroad Museum’s 27,000 square feet of trains, trestles, and tracks. Your group will learn more about our permanent exhibits, the art of model railroading, and Southern California Railroad History as well as have an opportunity for exclusive questions and answers sessions with docents and model train operators. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: Our ever-popular model railroad camp introduces beginner modelers to the basics of creating a mock model railroad. Older campers will create a working model railroad. Campers paint, plaster, lay track and construct a mini-town, complete with buildings, trees, trains, and people! All SDMRM camps are immersive, hands-on, and led by enthusiastic education professionals. Museum members receive early access to registration starting February 17, with public registration opening March 2, plus discounted camp pricing In this advanced, hands-on class, participants will design and build their own 4-foot by 8-inch model railroad layout from start to finish.
